name: threejs-world
description: Expand a scene idea into a detailed design, then build and visually inspect a rich, explorable Three.js world.

interface.shortDescription: Design and build richly detailed, explorable Three.js worlds.
interface.longDescription: Turn a short description of a place into a written world design, realize it as a walkable Three.js scene with a themed presentation layer, and inspect the rendered result until it matches the design.
defaultPrompt: Build an explorable 3D world from this scene idea.
Add a new region to the current Three.js world.
Review the current world against its design and fix what looks weak.
